title: PII-VisBench: Evaluating Personally Identifiable Information Safety in Vision Language Models Along a Continuum of Visibility
reasoning: The paper benchmarks and evaluates how Vision Language Models handle queries regarding a person's religion as part of its 20 PII attributes. Detailed results for the 'Religion' category, including refusal rates and disclosure patterns, are provided across multiple model families and visibility levels in the appendix tables (e.g., Tables 12, 13, 14, and 15).
